field.label: Enable
field.comment: Enable or disable the Pigeon Express shipping carrier.

group.label: API and environment
group.comment: Credentials and connection to Pigeon Express.

field.label: Test Mode
field.comment: Use the Pigeon Express test environment. Applies to every store. Each environment has its own keys; the keys of the chosen one are used. Offices, lockers and cities are kept separately for test and live, and switching schedules a sync.

field.label: API Key (test environment)
field.comment: Pigeon Express API key (X-API-Key) for the test environment. One account for every store.

field.label: API Secret (test environment)
field.comment: Pigeon Express API secret (X-API-Secret). If empty, API Key is used for both.

field.label: API Key (live environment)
field.comment: Pigeon Express API key (X-API-Key) for the live environment. One account for every store.

field.label: API Secret (live environment)
field.comment: Pigeon Express API secret (X-API-Secret). If empty, API Key is used for both.

field.label: Enable Logging / Error Handling
field.comment: Log API requests and errors for debugging.

field.label: Carrier Title
field.comment: Default carrier title (can be overridden per store).

field.label: Displayed Error Message
field.comment: Message shown when the method is unavailable.

group.label: Send From
group.comment: Where your parcels enter the Pigeon Express network. The office and locker lists fill in once your API credentials are saved and locations have synced.

field.label: Pickup Type
field.comment: How your parcels reach us: you drop them off at one of our offices, our couriers collect them from your address, or you leave them in a parcel locker. This is also the origin used when calculating rates.

field.label: Office
field.comment: Search by office name, town or street. You take your parcels to this office yourself, and it is also the origin used to calculate shipping rates.

field.label: Saved address
field.comment: The addresses saved in your Pigeon Express account. The courier collects from the one you choose. Add or change them in your account; the list here is refreshed with the location sync.

field.label: Parcel locker for hand-in
field.comment: The Pigeon Express parcel locker you leave shipments in. The list is populated from the most recent sync.

field.label: Office when the shipment does not fit a parcel locker
City
field.comment: Start typing and choose the city from the Pigeon Express list. The postal code is filled in from it.

field.label: Postal Code
field.comment: Filled in from the city. Only open for typing when Pigeon Express holds no postal code for it.

field.label: Street
field.comment: Choose the city first, then start typing and choose the street. If it is not on the list, type it; it is sent as written.

group.label: Courier request
group.comment: What a courier request proposes. You request a courier from the orders grid ("Request a Pigeon Express courier"), from the order ("Request a courier") or from Sales > Pigeon Express courier requests, and can change everything there. Shown only when the pickup type is "Address" or a saved address.

field.label: Pickup time from
field.comment: Start of the time the courier may come, as HH:MM. Default 10:00.

field.label: Pickup time to
field.comment: End of the time the courier may come, as HH:MM. It must be within the working hours of Pigeon Express. Default 17:00.

field.label: Same-day requests until
field.comment: Until this time the form proposes today, after it the next working day, and it shows how long today stays open. Pigeon Express still decides whether a date can be served. Default 15:00.

field.label: Type of shipments
field.comment: What the courier collects, so Pigeon Express sends a suitable vehicle.

field.label: Instructions for the courier
field.comment: Optional. Proposed in every courier request, for example where to ring or park.

field.label: Contact person
field.comment: Sent as the contact person of a courier request. Left empty, Pigeon Express uses the contact details of your account.

field.label: Contact phone
field.comment: Sent with courier requests, so the courier can call you. Left empty, Pigeon Express uses the contact details of your account.

field.label: Contact email
field.comment: Sent with courier requests. Left empty, Pigeon Express uses the contact details of your account.

group.label: Checkout and cash on delivery
group.comment: What the customer sees when ordering, which orders are sent as cash on delivery, and who pays the courier.

field.label: COD Payment Methods
field.comment: Payment methods that trigger a cash on delivery fee. The fee is set by Pigeon Express and read from the API for every quote.

field.label: Show COD Fee
field.comment: Show the cash on delivery fee next to each COD payment method at checkout, for example "Cash on delivery (+ 0.40 €)". Asks the API for the fee before the customer chooses, which adds one rate request per shipping recalculation.

field.label: Who pays the courier for cash on delivery orders
field.comment:
Pre-selected on orders paid by cash on delivery. Orders paid online, and orders with free delivery, always start on Sender: the customer has already paid the shop for delivery. You can still change it on each order.
It does not change what the customer is charged at checkout. If you choose Receiver, the courier collects the delivery charge on top of anything Magento has already billed, so set your shipping rate to zero for the affected delivery types, or leave this on Sender.

field.label: Override Address Fields
field.comment: With Yes, a customer choosing address delivery picks their city and street from Pigeon Express's lists instead of typing them, so the address always matches what we hold. With No, Magento's standard address fields are used.

field.label: Location Autocomplete Results
field.comment: Max number of Office/APS results in checkout autocomplete (e.g. 10–20).

field.label: Nearest office
field.comment: When a customer chooses office or parcel locker delivery, their browser asks them to share their location, and the five nearest offices or lockers are listed first. The location is used only to find them through Pigeon Express and is not stored with the order. A customer who declines sees the usual list.

field.label: Map of offices and lockers
field.comment: Adds a "Choose on the map" button to the office and parcel locker list at checkout. The map is from OpenStreetMap: when a customer opens it, the map images load from openstreetmap.org.

field.label: Checkout Logo
field.comment: Shown beside the Pigeon Express methods at checkout. Two of the versions are drawn in white for dark backgrounds and will be invisible on a light checkout, which is why they say so.

group.label: Additional Services
group.comment: Services applied to every shipment. Prices come from Pigeon Express. Only services in your account are listed, and one the chosen delivery method cannot perform is skipped.

field.label: ID Verification and Document Signature
field.comment: Verify ID and sign documents electronically.

field.label: Special Packaging
field.comment: Requires special packaging (requires_special_packaging). Enable only after Pigeon Express activates this service.

field.label: Insurance (Declared Value)
field.comment: Insure the contents of every parcel. The sum insured is the value of the goods in the order, sent to Pigeon Express.

field.label: Service Return Documents
field.comment: Return of original documents from the recipient to the sender after signing.

field.label: Return receipt
field.comment: Electronic: the recipient's signature comes back as a file. Paper: the signed receipt comes back to the shop. Each is charged separately. You can still change it on each order.

group.label: Address Delivery
group.comment: Door to door delivery to the address the customer enters.

field.label: Enable
field.comment: Enable delivery to address.

field.label: Title
field.comment: Label shown at checkout for this delivery type.

field.label: Flat Rate Price
field.comment: Charged instead of asking the API for a price. Cleared automatically if Pricing Mode is switched back to Dynamic.

field.label: Add COD Fee to Flat Rate
field.comment: Yes: a cash on delivery order pays the Pigeon Express COD fee on top of the flat rate, and it is shown next to the payment method. No: the flat rate is all the customer pays and you cover the COD fee.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

field.label: Recipient Inspection
field.comment: Let the recipient check the parcel before paying. Inspection only allows looking; Inspection and testing also allows trying the product. Only one is ever requested. Not available for parcel locker delivery.

field.label: Price when the rate cannot be calculated
field.comment: Charged when Pigeon Express cannot price the delivery. Leave empty to hide this method when Pigeon Express cannot price it. A parcel Pigeon Express cannot carry is hidden either way.

group.label: Office Delivery
group.comment: Delivery to a Pigeon Express counter office chosen by the customer.

field.label: Add COD Fee to Flat Rate
field.comment: Yes: a cash on delivery order pays the Pigeon Express COD fee on top of the flat rate, and it is shown next to the payment method. No: the flat rate is all the customer pays and you cover the COD fee.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

field.label: Recipient Inspection
field.comment: Let the recipient check the parcel before paying. Inspection only allows looking; Inspection and testing also allows trying the product. Only one is ever requested. Not available for parcel locker delivery.

field.label: Price when the rate cannot be calculated
field.comment: Charged when Pigeon Express cannot price the delivery. Leave empty to hide this method when Pigeon Express cannot price it. A parcel Pigeon Express cannot carry is hidden either way.

field.label: Show working hours
field.comment: Shows the working hours of the selected office in the checkout.

group.label: Parcel Locker (APS) Delivery
group.comment: Delivery to an automated parcel station chosen by the customer.

field.label: Add COD Fee to Flat Rate
field.comment: Yes: a cash on delivery order pays the Pigeon Express COD fee on top of the flat rate, and it is shown next to the payment method. No: the flat rate is all the customer pays and you cover the COD fee.

field.label: Enable Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: A cart price rule with the Free Shipping action still applies whether or not this is on.

field.label: Free Shipping Threshold
field.comment: Order subtotal, after discounts, at or above which this delivery type costs nothing. Set Who Pays to Sender as well, or the courier still collects the charge on delivery. Cleared automatically if the threshold is switched off.

field.label: Sort Order
field.comment: Position among the Pigeon Express options at checkout. Lower shows first.

field.label: Price when the rate cannot be calculated
field.comment: Charged when Pigeon Express cannot price the delivery. Leave empty to hide this method when Pigeon Express cannot price it. A parcel Pigeon Express cannot carry is hidden either way.

field.label: Show working hours
field.comment: Shows the working hours of the selected parcel locker in the checkout.

group.label: Returns and undelivered shipments
group.comment: What happens to shipments the recipient refuses or does not collect.

field.label: Return at my expense
field.comment: Pay for the return leg yourself when a shipment cannot be delivered. Leave off to have Pigeon Express charge the return to the recipient.

field.label: Where undelivered shipments return
field.comment: Leave on your Pigeon Express account to keep what it says. A chosen office or saved address with none picked also follows the account.

field.label: Return office
field.comment: A Pigeon Express office, not a parcel locker. The list is populated from the most recent sync.

field.label: Return address
field.comment: One of the addresses saved in your Pigeon Express account. Add or change them in your account; the list here is refreshed with the location sync.

field.label: Where return documents go
field.comment: Applies only to shipments with a return receipt or return documents.

field.label: Office for return documents
field.comment: A Pigeon Express office, not a parcel locker. The list is populated from the most recent sync.

field.label: Address for return documents
field.comment: One of the addresses saved in your Pigeon Express account. Add or change them in your account; the list here is refreshed with the location sync.

field.label: Return shipments
field.comment: The shop can create a return waybill from the order, for the customer to send the goods back. To enable them, contact your Pigeon Express representative.

group.label: Waybills
group.comment: What the waybill says and when shipments are created.

field.label: Label Contents
field.comment: What the waybill says the parcel holds. The carrier prints this, so everyone who handles the parcel can read it. A fixed description replaces every product name with one wording and drops the quantities, so the label reads "Contents: Clothing" rather than "Contents: 5 pcs. - Push It Messenger Bag". The insured sum and any cash on delivery travel separately and are unaffected.

field.label: Fixed Description
field.comment: Printed in place of every product name. Something the courier can act on but a bystander learns nothing from, for example "Стоки" or "Дрехи". Left empty, the label reads "Стоки".

field.label: Hide contents on the label
field.comment: The description is not printed on the label, but it is still sent to Pigeon Express.

field.label: Create shipments automatically
field.comment: Create the shipment automatically when the order becomes Processing, or as soon as it is placed when it is paid by cash on delivery. If data is missing, the order gets a comment and you create the shipment by hand. In Live mode these are real, billed shipments.

group.label: Shipment status and tracking
group.comment: Follows where each shipment is and, if you want, updates the order when it is delivered or comes back.

field.label: Track shipment status
field.comment: Twice a day, checks where each shipment is and shows it on the order. On its own it never changes the order.

field.label: When the shipment is delivered
field.comment: Complete the order: the order becomes Complete. For cash on delivery orders the invoice is created automatically.

field.label: When the shipment comes back
field.comment: For example when the customer refuses it. An order that already has an invoice cannot be cancelled or held; it only gets a note.

field.label: Create the Magento shipment
field.comment: Marks the order as shipped with the tracking number when the waybill is created. The customer gets an email with the number. If you cancel the Pigeon Express shipment, the number is removed again.

group.label: Parcel weight and dimensions
group.comment: Which product attributes hold weight and size, what to fall back on when a product has none, and how packages are marked.

field.label: Weight Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package weight (kg). If empty, Magento standard weight field will be used.

field.label: Length Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package length (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Width Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package width (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Height Attribute
field.comment: Select product attribute used for package height (cm). If empty, a default value will be used.

field.label: Default Weight (kg)
field.comment: Used when a product has no weight value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without weight.

field.label: Default Length (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no length value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

field.label: Default Width (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no width value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

field.label: Default Height (cm)
field.comment: Used when a product has no height value. Set to 0 to hide shipping methods for products without dimensions.

field.label: How to Apply the Defaults
field.comment:
Once per shipment: products without a weight or size share one default parcel; products that have values are added on top.
Always one default parcel: product weights and sizes are ignored and every shipment is sent as the default weight and size above. Use this when product weights are only placeholders.
For every item: the defaults are added for each unit, so three items weigh three times the default.

field.label: Locker Compartment Width (cm)
field.comment: Only the locker compartment is checked here; the other limits come from Pigeon Express when a parcel is priced. Leave a side at 0 to skip the check.

field.label: Fragile packages
field.comment: Marks packages as fragile so the courier handles them with care. This is not insurance: for that, use declared value. With "Chosen for each package on the order" you tick it per package when creating the shipment.

group.label: Sync and diagnostics
group.comment: Offices, lockers, cities and the service catalogue are refreshed nightly.

field.label: Manual Sync
field.comment: Schedules a manual sync of offices and APS lockers from Pigeon Express API. Runs on the next cron tick (~1 min).
